versions.changelog:
- Updated the SKILL.md documentation to clarify API Key registration and free credits details, including new user and daily allocation.
- Added a new section on earning more credits via referrals, recharge, or daily renewal.
- Improved guidance on obtaining and using the Cue API Key.
- Removed the redundant skill-card.md file.

cue-legal-compliance v1.0.0

- Initial release of the Cue「法律合规」research skill.
- Enables in-depth research on legal compliance scenarios: rapid retrieval of domestic laws/regulations, analysis of legislative background, and compliance essentials.
- Supports compliance risk assessments, regulatory inquiry case libraries, complex legal practice case libraries, regulation surveys, legal problem assessments, regulatory radar, and litigation drafting.
- Provides step-by-step guidance for setting up and running Cue-based research runners.
- Explicitly requires credit confirmation before each research run, ensuring transparency in resource usage.
- All findings are sourced with links; no unsupported content is generated.
